name: Resentment
overview: Scripture reveals that resentment, expressed through wrath and envy, harms the foolish and vulnerable, leading to spiritual and emotional death. The Psalms reflect the deep sorrow and anguish that resentment brings, yet also point to God's power to restore and revive those afflicted. Central to overcoming resentment is the call to forgive others, as emphasized in the teachings of Jesus, who links our forgiveness of others directly to receiving forgiveness from God. Thus, the Bible presents forgiveness as the divine remedy for the destructive effects of resentment.
